carriers.title: Carriers
carriers.description: Your carriers. `tracking_url_template` is an https:// link with {tracking} where the tracking number goes; leave it empty for a carrier without tracking pages. `service_levels` are the services you book with the carrier.

allow_other_carrier.title: Allow a carrier that is not in the list
allow_other_carrier.description: Free-text carrier names (no tracking link) for one-off shipments.

dispatch_video.title: Record a dispatch video link
dispatch_video.description: Keep an https:// link to a packing or dispatch video on the order (evidence for disputes).

show_tracking_to_customer.title: Show carrier and tracking to the customer

show_video_to_customer.title: Show the dispatch video link to the customer
